# Contributing to TM {{PROJECT_NAME}}

Thank you for contributing to the TM Open Source ecosystem!

## Standards
1. Follow the [TM Open Source Standard](https://github.com/tmolavi/molavi-agentic-os/blob/main/TM-OPEN-SOURCE-STANDARD.md).
2. All pull requests must pass automated tests with 100% success rate.
3. Keep diffs minimal and preserve clean provenance.
4. Run `python scripts/check_governance.py` before submitting.
